bounded_question: What governed course-location and timezone reference is required to interpret source off-times safely across all course identities in the current source extract?

manual_verification_closure.recovery_basis: The archived geocoding request log preserves both cited request timestamps on 26 July 2026.
manual_verification_closure.validation_rule: Each specialist record must match the exact governed course-location row, raw source label, manually_validated status and IANA timezone.

database_consequences: Preserve raw date, course and off values unchanged.
Derive candidate_course_label and candidate_jurisdiction before joining raw source rows to the governed reference.
Join canonical identities using candidate_course_label plus candidate_jurisdiction.
Treat raw_course_labels as construction provenance rather than a production join key.
Store iana_timezone separately from raw off-time text.
Preserve timezone resolution method, evidence and manual verification identifier.
Allow exact venue coordinates to remain nullable enrichment.
Reject duplicate course-reference identities and multiple matches.
Expose unmatched future source identities as a clear review residue and fail in strict validation contexts.
Allow one raw label to resolve to different governed identities only where explicit race context makes each source row deterministic.

durable_source_join_repair.reason: Notebook 14 exposed a direct raw course to raw_course_labels join that bypassed the governed canonical derivation and produced seven false unmatched labels.
durable_source_join_repair.replacement_contract: Use merge_source_course_locations to preserve raw course text, derive the canonical identity from race context, validate a many-to-one reference match and expose unmatched residue.
durable_source_join_repair.contextual_collisions: Ascot and Newcastle legitimately resolve to Great Britain or Australia from governed date, race-type and race-name context; raw-label uniqueness is not required.
durable_source_join_repair.notebook_rerun_claim: No fresh-kernel rerun is claimed. Durable implementation and independent validation supersede the incorrect direct-join conclusion.

limitations: Exact physical venue details remain incomplete for some course identities.
Historical venue changes may later require effective-period treatment.
